finding_or_allegation: Six defendants guilty of terrorist murder or attempt; eight guilty of participating in terrorist group activities; two fully acquitted. Same proceeding for Maelbeek.
Court spokesperson reported no cassation filings by deadline; no duplicate legal count for shared sites.
Europol describes coordination between sites and links of participants to the Paris network. Court reporting separately establishes group participation.
Special assize appeal court imposed 18 years each for terrorist criminal association; court source does not equate the two defendants with perpetration of murders.
Criminal chamber pourvoi 24-84.288; both 18-year dispositions became final.
IS claimed attack after event. Europol said a link had not been confirmed at its cutoff.
Europol records public responsibility claim and pre-attack allegiance video; separate from proved membership or direction.

Federal prosecutor told committee that Amri had personal contacts with IS fighters while formal membership was unsupported by the evidence known to authorities. No adjudicated command finding in that testimony.
Celle court reports attempted murder and terrorism-group support findings. The separate national finding does not resolve Europol slot identity.
Hoge Raad upheld terrorist intent in the arson judgment. Europol counted the attack as failed.
Judiciary summary records life sentence with minimum 22 years and appeal disposition.
Crown Court conviction and whole-life sentence for murder. Original Europol UK attack table covers NI-related entries only.
Atar and two others received life sentences; the reported Atar verdict concerns 35 murder victims. The proceeding covers both sites.
Belga reports the jury found Atar led the cell and selected and instructed members. This is evidence of individual direction at cell level; no further command-chain finding is inferred.
